title: 'Legal cockroaches united': CJP hails planned protest for Bar chief's resignation

This follows the chairman's apology to law students regarding the NALSAR University controversy.  The initial directive barred NALSAR graduating students from becoming advocates.  The controversy involved a campaign against the Chief Justice of India's convocation participation.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

title: Former wrestler arrested in Delhi opium case; claims drug use in ‘akhadas’
content: In a dramatic turn of events, Delhi Police have arrested Amit Sheoran, a former national-level wrestler, after he spent three years on the run from charges of opium smuggling. Sheoran's claims that fellow wrestlers resort to opium to enhance training efforts have stirred controversy. His identification as a key figure by another arrested supplier highlights the ongoing battle against organised crime in the region.

title: Hockey WC: India extend dominance over Pakistan with 5-3 thriller, seal next-round spot
content: In a thrilling Pool D showdown, India triumphed over Pakistan with a score of 5-3. With Harmanpreet Singh and Abhishek each netting two goals, India showcased their strength. Pakistan's Hannan Shahid and Sufyan Khan put up a valiant effort by scoring, yet India held their ground during the nail-biting final quarter, securing their advancement to the next stage of the World Cup.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: Beginning September 18, 2026, new rules from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will reshape the Green Card application landscape. Applicants will undergo a more rigorous public charge evaluation that now includes a broader range of public benefits. Additionally, previous cash assistance and long-term institutional stays will factor into decisions, significantly affecting family and employment-based immigration cases.

title: Habitat restored for gopher tortoises later became home to 500 endangered frogs
content: In a significant conservation effort, Mississippi wetlands welcomed the release of nearly 500 captive-reared dusky gopher frogs, marking the establishment of the sole active population in Hancock County. These frogs critically rely on gopher tortoise burrows for their survival. As private landowners take on a larger role in wildlife preservation, monitoring will be implemented to evaluate the stability of this new frog population.

title: Maine island bought by 27-year-old in 1964 later became wildlife sanctuary
content: Witch Island, previously inhabited by the infamous Anna Chittenden—referred to as the 'Witch of Wall Street'—has transformed into a wildlife sanctuary. After her brief stay, Jane Sewall took on the responsibility of safeguarding the isle from irresponsible tourists. In 1986, Sewall gifted the island to the Maine Audubon Society, which is now overseen by the Coastal Rivers Conservation Trust.

title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call
content: Better Home & Finance is suing former CEO Vishal Garg in a US court. The company seeks to block Garg from gathering shareholder support for his return. Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.

title: 'Every Test match victory is special': KL Rahul after 165-run victory vs SL

He praised the team for executing its plans and credited thorough preparation for their success. Rahul also lauded Devdutt Padikkal’s maiden Test century, calling it a defining moment that helped set up the victory and hoping the young batter carries his confidence into future matches.

title: From Taco Tuesday to Fitting Friday: Trump puts Canada tariffs on ice for 72 hours

Substantial progress has been acknowledged, though significant work remains to finalize an agreement. The immediate dispute centers on Canadian trade practices and market access for American goods. Both nations aim to resolve these issues before the extended deadline expires.

Overcoming crowd pressure, a head injury and Sen’s aggressive play, Tan triumphed 19-21, 21-19, 21-17, marking the biggest win of his career.

This discovery reshapes our understanding of ancient maritime cultural exchanges.

title: 'We are Gen Z' is new 'jaantay nahin ho mera baap kaun hai': J&K CM on viral video
content: video shows a woman at a checkpoint in Kargil arguing with security personnel . the woman is heard saying, “We are Gen-Z and we won't tolerate this nonsense”, while questioning why tourists were being subjected to restrictions . she also alleges that the phrase “we are Gen Z” could become a new form of entitlement .

title: 'PM under pressure': Rahul at Cong meet; party plans grassroots campaign to corner govt
content: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has asked the party's chief ministers to work with education experts and prepare a roadmap for overhauling the education and examination system . the meeting, chaired by Congress president, brought together 88 leaders, including former party chiefs .

title: Trump-Bibi tensions deepen? US officials frustrated by Israel’s Syria strikes: Report
